GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 370.05 (24 Nov 45) GC
(SCAPIN - 341)
24 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of Chinese Laborers on board the S. S. Meiyu-maru.
1. Reference is made to your request in C.L.O.No. 680 (5.3), dated 20 November 1945, subject: "Request for Permission to Repatriate Chinese Laborers on board the S.S. Meiyu-Maru."
2. Permission id granted to place aboard the Japanese ship Meiyu-Maru for repatriation the 1, 352 Chinese laborers subject of the cited reference.
3. According to the latest available information the Maiyu-Maru is scheduled to sail from Hakata for Shanghai on 27 November 1945.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
